title: karpenter chart values (partial schema)
description: Validates the settings.flavors overrides and the boolean toggles at helm install/upgrade time, before a typo reaches the controller. Flavor entries are closed objects with a constrained name: the controller refuses the whole overrides file on a key it does not know (a typo, or the priceHourly that earlier releases accepted), or on a name that cannot be a Clever Cloud flavor, and runs without any override, so either must fail the upgrade here instead. The booleans need typing because the templates gate on Go-template truthiness, where any non-empty string is true: a quoted "false" (--set-string, or a quoted values file) would render the exact opposite of its intent. Everything else is intentionally unconstrained, unknown keys included: values a past release consumed and a later one removed (settings.pricing) must keep rendering when an upgrade still carries them (values reused from the previous release, or an old values file).

enabled.description: Expose the metrics endpoint through a ClusterIP service.

disableLeaderElection.description: Disable leader election. The string "false" would still disable it — two active controllers with replicas>1.

name.description: Flavor name, uppercase as the NodeGroup API takes it: one of 2XS, XS, S, M, L, XL, or a new flavor named the same way (M, or S or L optionally prefixed by X or 2X to 9X, such as 2XL). The pattern is the controller's (instancetype.FlavorNamePattern): a name the NodeGroup API can never accept (2xs, CUSTOM) would enter the catalogue and fail every launch it wins, so the controller refuses the whole overrides file on it. A name outside the built-in catalogue introduces a new flavor and must also set cpu and memoryKi.
